entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Blade)

system.description: Gain +3 Atk and +3 Eva when counterattacking with a Blade weapon in melee range.
Protected from Lightning damage. Vulnerable to Piercing damage.
Gain +4 Atk when initiating a melee attack against a foe. Does not apply to Brawling weapons.

A keen weapon, meant to cut through armor. 

Eff. vs Armored, Brawlbreaker
If this unit is wielding a Blade weapon, melee attacks that Miss against them cause the attacker to suffer 2 Brk damage.
